## Rules

- Closed statuses are `complete`, `incomplete`, `failed`; only `complete` authorizes absence reconciliation. A valid complete empty tab is possible only after card/page identity and documents container semantics are verified. One malformed/suppressed candidate makes snapshot incomplete unless an exact source rule proves it non-document. Root selection uses explicit parent/origin fields, not external-id string heuristics. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).

## Guidance

Parser remains HTML→DTO with no persistence. Indexer accepts `DocumentsSnapshot`, not raw list. Negative tests must prove old `[]` would remove rows; fixed path preserves them and emits observable incomplete/failed outcome. Expand a real archive via `ExpandArchiveEntryAction`, then reindex unchanged parent and assert child active. No `try/catch` returning empty list. Do not special-case fixture UIDs or title strings.
